name: mtp-fence-pinret-bd6a6f982-tc-hm0-f9b
purpose: FILL-9 2026-10-10 floorplan knob vs f9a: 480x300 frame (same core area class) so the 4.1k-bit top (host_w*) and bottom (cap_data) buses get 468 um faces: 4.4 b/um/layer instead of 5.9, half the bank depth, shorter pin->bank->logic wires on the in->reg paths that limited p2r2/p2r3 (TT -56 in->reg). Same RTL/benches/tapcell-aware bank as f9a. | FILL-9 2026-10-10 root cause of f8 NEEDS_HUMAN (calibrate died 3_5_place_dp DPL-0033): pinret_bank.tcl put 97 FIRM pin flops on top of TAP_TAPCELL_ROW_* (it only tracked its own used sites). Fix: reserve every row site under a fixed instance before assigning the bank. Same RTL/benches/floorplan as f8 (bus-tolerant exhaustive pin regions). | was: FILL-8 2026-10-10 root cause of f7 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN (S/M5 12.96 b/um @120, 1296 pins/100 um): the top pin-region regex '^(host_wr_.*|host_dst|host_wdata)$' is matched by Tcl regexp on bit names ('host_wdata[5]'), so host_wdata[4096]+host_dst[9] were UNCONSTRAINED and spread over all four faces (N 1252, S 1300 on top of cap_data 4096, E 818, W 726; N M7 empty) -> long pin->flop wires across the die. Fix: bus-index-tolerant regex + --pin-regions-exhaustive (every port in exactly one region); top face then carries 4107 pins balanced M5/M7 = 5.9 b/um/layer, bottom 4116 = 5.9. Same RTL/benches as f7 (10a658adf). | FILL-7 2026-10-10 (drive-1010 IDLE round 1): pin-flop anchoring hook fix: pinret_bank.tcl matched the returned-credit capture flops by Q-net name (renamed after mapping -> 'got 0' at 3_3_place_gp); now matches the flop instance; RTL un
